# SectionLink

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A clickable internal cross-reference. Unlike a plain `Hyperlink` (which needs an explicit `TargetPageIndex`), a SectionLink targets a named `Section` - or a `Heading` carrying an `AnchorId` - by id and resolves the destination page at render time from the shared `TocEntries` registry.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `Hyperlink`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new SectionLink(string text, string anchorTarget)
```

## Properties

- [`AnchorTarget`](#anchortarget): The anchor id this link jumps to (a `Section` or anchored `Heading`).

### `AnchorTarget`

```csharp
string AnchorTarget { get; }
```

*read-only*

The anchor id this link jumps to (a `Section` or anchored `Heading`).

## Methods

- [`Render`](#render): Resolves `AnchorTarget` to a 0-based page index from the seeded TOC registry, then delegates to the base `Hyperlink` render/annotation path.

### `Render`

```csharp
void Render(RenderContext ctx, float width)
```

Resolves `AnchorTarget` to a 0-based page index from the seeded TOC registry, then delegates to the base `Hyperlink` render/annotation path. Falls back to the first page when the target was never registered (unknown id / single-pass layout), matching the VisualToc behaviour.
